resources.string: Mouse reporting activates automatically when the remote application requests it. For tmux, enable “set -g mouse on”.
Tap: focus the terminal and show the keyboard. In mouse-aware apps, also send a left click at the touched cell.
Swipe up or down: scroll the remote app using mouse-wheel events. When mouse reporting is off, scroll terminal history.
Touch and hold, then drag: hold the left mouse button to drag or select inside the remote app. Lift your finger to release.
Double tap: select a word locally and open the Android copy menu. When mouse reporting is off, long press also selects text.
Pinch: change terminal font size. Pinching ends any active mouse drag.
External mouse: left/middle/right buttons, wheel, and application-requested motion reporting. Hold Shift to use local scrolling and selection instead.
Two-finger tap or hold: right-click. Keep both fingers held for menus such as tmux that close on release; use the keyboard to choose an item, then lift your fingers.
